#en: Warning: This unit is well equipped for combat.
zh: 警告：该单位装备精良，适合战斗。

#en: Calling for the big guns, huh? You're the boss!
zh: 叫大炮了，嗯？你说了算！

#en: Request denied... That Skydrop is out of stock.
zh: 请求被拒……那个空投没货了。

#en: Prepping a little "firework package". Stand by.
zh: 正在准备一个「烟花包裹」。请稍候。

#en: Sounds like something that should be dealt with.
zh: 听起来该处理一下。

#en: First rule. This is my home, and you're a guest.
zh: 第一条规矩。这是我的家，你是客人。

#en: I hope you find the Fleet Command system useful.
zh: 希望舰队指挥系统对你有用。

#en: There. I think... Yeah. I think we're done here.
zh: 好了。我想……对。我看就这样吧。

#en: Good. Better with us than in Watchtower's hands.
zh: 好。在我们手里总比落在瞭望塔手里强。

#en: Ah, really? A shame. It was nice to reminisce...
zh: 啊，真的？可惜。叙旧挺愉快的……

#en: I'd like to learn more about the Field Surgeons.
zh: 我想多了解一些战地医师的事。

#en: I've seen worse, but a little TLC wouldn't hurt.
zh: 我见过更糟的，不过稍微照料一下也没坏处。

#en: Your choice, but come back if it gets any worse.
zh: 随你，但要是恶化了就回来。

#en: Fine, but don't blame me when something festers.
zh: 行，但要是烂起来别怪我。

#en: That's fine. Nothing was finalized. So what now?
zh: 没关系。什么都还没定。那现在怎么办？

#en: We lack the number of cores needed for that one.
zh: 那个所需的核心数我们不够。

#en: I've gathered some things you might find useful.
zh: 我准备了些你可能用得上的东西。

#en: I'll need a moment to prep the micro foundry...
zh: 我需要一点时间准备微型铸造厂……

#en: [2 Watchtower Components] Surface Toxic Gas Bomb
zh: [2 瞭望塔部件] 地表毒气弹

#en: [1 Watchtower Component] Turret Drop - Ballistic
zh: [1 瞭望塔部件] 炮塔空投 - 弹道

#en: These are the drops I'm equipped to fabricate...
zh: 这些是我有能力制造的空投……

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Surface Bombardment
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表轰炸

#en: [2 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Turret Drop - Laser
zh: [2 计算机核心] 空投 - 炮塔空投 - 激光

#en: What brings you back to my corner of the cosmos?
zh: 什么风把你吹回我这一角宇宙了？

#en: Please await support from certified technicians.
zh: 请等待认证技术人员的支援。

#en: Upsy-daisy... Yeah, yeah, open those eyes now...
zh: 起来吧……对，对，睁开眼睛……

#en: Ah, hey! That looks like the Control Node to me!
zh: 啊，嘿！我看那就是控制节点！

#en: I need some time to prepare, I'll be back later.
zh: 我需要点时间准备，我晚点回来。

#en: Like I said before, my name's Torin! Just Torin.
zh: 我说过了，我叫托林！就叫托林。

#en: Alright, tell me about this "strategy" of yours.
zh: 好，说说你的这个「策略」。

#en: Regardless, I'll start getting them ready for...
zh: 不管怎样，我开始让他们准备好……

#en: Hmm... I'm seeing a file, but I'm denied access.
zh: 嗯……我看到一个文件，但我没有访问权限。

#en: I'm unsure if we'll visit more Listening Posts...
zh: 我不确定我们还会不会去别的监听哨……

#en: [Install Skydrop] Sounds good to me, let's do it.
zh: [安装空投] 我觉得不错，动手吧。

#en: Why do we need this particular piece of hardware?
zh: 我们为什么需要这件特定的硬件？

#en: Not to be rude, but your face...? Are you unwell?
zh: 无意冒犯，但你的脸……？你不舒服吗？

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Supernova Armillary.
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 超新星浑天仪。

#en: What corporations does Watchtower have ties with?
zh: 瞭望塔和哪些企业有联系？

#en: What sort of rank structure does Watchtower have?
zh: 瞭望塔的等级体系是怎样的？

#en: This won't take too long. Care to lend a hand...?
zh: 不会太久。愿意搭把手吗……？

#en: [10 Watchtower Components] Surface Supernova Bomb
zh: [10 瞭望塔部件] 地表超新星炸弹

#en: [3 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Surface Laser Cannon
zh: [3 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表激光炮

#en: Good choice. Shall I proceed with the extraction?
zh: 好选择。要我继续提取吗？

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Surface Inferno Bomb
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表炼狱炸弹

#en: This slate contains potential Skydrops. Pick one.
zh: 这块数据板上有可选空投。挑一个。

#en: I know what that's like, I walked a similar path.
zh: 我懂那种感觉，我走过类似的路。

#en: I'm sorry. I really do get here as fast as I can!
zh: 抱歉。我真的是尽快赶来了！

#en: It's drone busting time! Then down to the planet.
zh: 该打无人机了！然后降落行星。

#en: Do the scan and I'll take care of drone spotting.
zh: 你负责扫描，我来盯无人机。

#en: Not now, there's a few things I need to do first.
zh: 现在不行，我先有几件事要办。

#en: Yeah, they often do. At least from my experience.
zh: 是啊，通常都会。至少以我的经验是这样。

#en: What have you been doing since the last universe?
zh: 上个宇宙之后你都在做什么？

#en: Ah, think nothing of it! Just doing what's right.
zh: 啊，别在意！只是做该做的事。

#en: Not sure I get it. How exactly does this help me?
zh: 我不太明白。这到底怎么帮到我？

#en: Fine, I'm listening. Tell me what I need to know.
zh: 好吧，我在听。告诉我我该知道的。

#en: Let me guess, the Intel Slate is purging its data?
zh: 让我猜猜，情报数据板在清除数据？

#en: We'll get right to it! Be back before you know it.
zh: 我们这就去办！转眼就回来。

#en: Can we postpone? I'd rather not do this right now.
zh: 能往后推吗？我现在不太想做这个。

#en: No questions, but I do need help building a fleet.
zh: 没问题了，但我需要人帮我组建舰队。

#en: Forget the ugly stick. The whole TREE fell on you!
zh: 别说什么棍子了。整棵树都砸你脸上了！

#en: It's up to you what we do. Lead and I will follow.
zh: 怎么做你决定。你带头，我跟着。

#en: What do you make of the Watchtower Computer Cores?
zh: 你怎么看瞭望塔的计算机核心？

#en: This part takes a steady nerve and a sharp mind...
zh: 这一步需要沉稳的胆识和敏锐的头脑……

#en: Success! A new Amp prepped and ready for assembly.
zh: 成功！一个新增幅已准备好组装。

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Reanimator Armillary.
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 复活者浑天仪。

#en: Obviously, that's not the end. What happened next?
zh: 显然那不是结局。后来呢？

#en: Understood. Perhaps we can also install a Skydrop.
zh: 明白。也许我们还能装个空投。

#en: I've compiled a slate of the available Skydrops...
zh: 我把可用空投整理成数据板了……

#en: Ah! But it does have a Synapse Disruptor. Perfect.
zh: 啊！但它装了一台突触干扰器。完美。

#en: Throw those breakers! We're not at full power yet!
zh: 去扳那些开关！电力还没满！

#en: Get to those switches! We're still short on juice.
zh: 快去那些开关那儿！电还不够。

#en: Warning: Skydrop Mech bootup sequence in progress.
zh: 警告：空投机甲启动程序进行中。

#en: *sigh* Okay... sure, sure, why not? Let's do it...
zh: *叹气* 好吧……行，行，有何不可？那就干吧……

#en: No need to worry about the mech. Back to Stardock!
zh: 不用担心那台机甲。回星坞去！

#en: Get moving inside. I'll find you as soon as I can!
zh: 快进去。我尽快找到你！

#en: Entry point cleared! Facility's open for business!
zh: 入口已清理！设施可以进人了！

#en: Okay, drones now, planet later. Let's get started!
zh: 好，先打无人机，再下行星。开始吧！

#en: Yep, there they are! Watchtower drones closing in.
zh: 对，它们在那儿！瞭望塔无人机正在逼近。

#en: ...Ah! Yeah, you're... you're welcome! I think...?
zh: ……啊！对，不……不用谢！我想是吧……？

#en: Well, that was fun. You should call me more often.
zh: 嗯，挺有意思。你该多叫我几次。

#en: Okay! See if you can find that intel Harper wanted.
zh: 好！看看你能不能找到哈珀要的情报。

#en: If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
zh: 你要是改主意，知道上哪儿找我。

#en: I suppose it'll do. I was sort of expecting more...
zh: 我想应该够用。我还以为会更多些……

#en: Come back when you do! We'll be waiting right here.
zh: 找到了就回来！我们就在这儿等。

#en: Thanks, but no thanks. I'll get my own second ship.
zh: 谢了，不用。我自己弄第二艘船。

#en: Is there anything you can tell me about Watchtower?
zh: 关于瞭望塔你有什么能告诉我的吗？

#en: But I did have a way out! A sort of... escape plan!
zh: 但我确实有出路！算是……一个逃生计划！

#en: I don't see anything wrong! A clean bill of health.
zh: 我看不出任何问题！身体健康得很。

#en: Another selection, then? No rush, take your time...
zh: 又要挑一个？不急，慢慢来……

#en: And if Torin trusts her, then that's enough for me.
zh: 如果托林信她，那对我就够了。

#en: Harper. Hm. I find interacting with her... awkward.
zh: 哈珀。嗯。我觉得跟她打交道……很别扭。

#en: On second thought, let's build a different Skydrop.
zh: 我再想想，还是造个别的空投吧。

#en: [5 Watchtower Components] Turret Drop - Heavy Laser
zh: [5 瞭望塔部件] 炮塔空投 - 重型激光

#en: [1 Computer Core] Skydrop - Turret Drop - Ballistic
zh: [1 计算机核心] 空投 - 炮塔空投 - 弹道

#en: [2 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Surface Toxic Gas Bomb
zh: [2 计算机核心] 空投 - 地表毒气弹

#en: Give me a moment to complete the data extraction...
zh: 给我一点时间完成数据提取……

#en: Hey, where are you going? Come back! I wasn't done.
zh: 嘿，你去哪儿？回来！我还没说完。

#en: You mentioned other kinds of Watchtower technology?
zh: 你提到过瞭望塔的其他技术？

#en: Could Gren not help you decipher the Computer Core?
zh: 格伦不能帮你破解那块计算机核心吗？

#en: What are you doing?! Are you even listening to me?!
zh: 你在干什么？！你有在听我说话吗？！

#en: What can I say? I saw a path forward and I took it.
zh: 我能说什么？我看到一条出路就抓住了。

#en: ...Yup! We hit the threshold, firing the disruptor!
zh: ……对！达到阈值了，发射干扰器！

#en: Nice! But the Corvette's still thirsty. Keep it up!
zh: 不错！但护卫舰还很渴。继续！

#en: Target locked, missile loaded. Skydrop is en route!
zh: 目标锁定，导弹装填。空投已在路上！

#en: Correct! Lead on, and I'll be right there with you.
zh: 没错！你带路，我紧随其后。

#en: Hey, you found it! All by yourself, too. Well done.
zh: 嘿，你找到了！还是自己找的。干得好。

#en: Fantastic! We're able to expand our fleet once more!
zh: 太好了！我们又能扩充舰队了！

#en: That was a considerate gesture, revealing your face.
zh: 你肯露出真面目，这很体贴。

#en: I take it that means you recovered the Control Node.
zh: 这么说你找回了控制节点。

#en: What can you tell me about Harper? Can we trust her?
zh: 哈珀的情况你知道些什么？能信她吗？

#en: Alright, another time then. My clinic's always open.
zh: 好，那就改天。我的诊所随时开张。

#en: Just a moment, and I'll tease out the needed data...
zh: 稍等，我把需要的数据理出来……

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Gravity Well Armillary.
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 重力井浑天仪。

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Gravity Wave Armillary.
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 重力波浑天仪。

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Anti-Gravity Armillary.
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 反重力浑天仪。

#en: This won't take me long. Grab a snack if you'd like.
zh: 不会太久。想吃点东西就随意。

#en: Enforce loyalty? Watchtower brainwashes its members?
zh: 强制忠诚？瞭望塔会给成员洗脑？

#en: [10 Watchtower Components] Surface Gravity Well Bomb
zh: [10 瞭望塔部件] 地表重力井炸弹

#en: The Skydrop system has been successfully integrated.
zh: 空投系统已成功整合。

#en: [10 Watchtower Components] Surface Anti-Gravity Bomb
zh: [10 瞭望塔部件] 地表反重力炸弹

#en: [10 Watchtower Components] Surface Gravity Wave Bomb
zh: [10 瞭望塔部件] 地表重力波炸弹

#en: Why did the Freestar Collective abandon the station?
zh: 自由星系联盟为什么放弃了这座空间站？

#en: And one more Post location from that second slate...
zh: 第二块数据板上还有一个监听哨位置……

#en: Well, if it isn't my second favorite troublemaker...
zh: 哟，这不是我第二喜欢的捣蛋鬼嘛……

#en: System green, missile online. Skydrop firing... now!
zh: 系统正常，导弹上线。空投发射……现在！

#en: If that's your call! Now to see if I can find her...
zh: 既然你决定了！那去看看我能不能找到她……

#en: [6 Astra] Hire the Advocate to get the Control Node.
zh: [6 阿斯特拉] 雇佣辩护者去取控制节点。

#en: Not noticed anything yet! But it's still early days.
zh: 还没发现什么！不过才刚开始。

#en: But how did you know Watchtower were looking for me?
zh: 但你怎么知道瞭望塔在找我？

#en: I have... abilities. Things a normal human can't do.
zh: 我有……一些能力。常人做不到的事。

#en: No can do. That Skydrop's spent, try something else.
zh: 不行。那个空投用完了，换别的吧。

#en: Do not resist, and the processing will be over soon.
zh: 不要反抗，处理很快就会结束。

#en: Am I detecting... Are there Watchtower troops there?!
zh: 我是不是探测到……那儿有瞭望塔部队？！

#en: Great! We have the ability to build up a fleet again.
zh: 太好了！我们又能组建舰队了。

#en: But our helmets and suits help mitigate these issues.
zh: 但我们的头盔和制服能缓解这些问题。

#en: We can talk more on the subject later, if you'd like.
zh: 如果你愿意，这个话题我们以后可以再聊。

#en: Can you tell me anything about Aetherium Cybernetics?
zh: 能给我讲讲以太赛博公司吗？

#en: [Unlock Cyberamp] I'd like to extract a new Cyberamp.
zh: [解锁赛博增幅] 我想提取一个新的赛博增幅。

#en: As you wish. If you need something else, let me know.
zh: 如你所愿。还需要别的就告诉我。

#en: It won't take me long. Please wait as I resupply you.
zh: 不会太久。请稍候，我为你补货。

#en: No restock is required. All modules are fully loaded.
zh: 无需补货。所有模块已满载。

#en: [Install Skydrop] Yes, I'd like to install a Skydrop.
zh: [安装空投] 对，我想安装一个空投。

#en: All right. I need to recalibrate the assembly line...
zh: 好。我需要重新校准装配线……

#en: I'll start retrieving the Skydrop data. Be patient...
zh: 我开始调取空投数据。请耐心……

#en: Beginning the extraction now. This won't take long...
zh: 现在开始提取。不会太久……

#en: I can handle that. Are you happy with your selection?
zh: 这个我能办。你对所选满意吗？

#en: I'd like to hear more about your time living in Neon.
zh: 我想多听听你在霓虹城生活的日子。

#en: Sure thing. Always here if you wanna talk more later.
zh: 没问题。以后想再聊，我随时都在。

#en: Give me a second, and I'll pull whatever's on here...
zh: 等我一下，我把这里面的都调出来……

#en: Just give the planet a scan with your ship's sensors.
zh: 用飞船传感器把这颗行星扫描一遍就行。

#en: Mech outta control? Drop something big on it! Hahaha!
zh: 机甲失控了？那就往它头上扔个大家伙！哈哈哈！

#en: Lining up my shot now. Get out of range of that mech.
zh: 我正在瞄准。离那台机甲远点。

#en: Mech's out. Let's give it a warm reception, shall we?
zh: 机甲出动了。我们热情接待一下，如何？

#en: Lock achieved, missile is live. Skydrop heading down!
zh: 已锁定，导弹就绪。空投正在下降！

#en: Aaand Watchtower drones inbound. Exactly on schedule.
zh: 瞭望塔无人机来了。完全准时。

#en: Make your way there, and I'll start prepping Skydrop.
zh: 你往那边去，我开始准备空投。

#en: Once you're there, I'll provide further instructions.
zh: 你到了之后，我再给你进一步指示。

#en: Anything you can tell me about the Synapse Disruptor?
zh: 关于突触干扰器你有什么能说的吗？

#en: Hah! Well, glad you're staying optimistic! Alright...
zh: 哈！很高兴你还这么乐观！好吧……

#en: Y'know, this Watchtower thing isn't going to go away.
zh: 你知道，瞭望塔这事不会自己消失。

#en: Good to see you back. Any news on that Listening Post?
zh: 很高兴看到你回来。那个监听哨有什么消息？

#en: That's enough questions, I need help building a fleet.
zh: 问题问够了，我需要人帮我组建舰队。

#en: So, we've got the Control Node, how do we get a fleet?
zh: 那么，我们拿到控制节点了，怎么搞到舰队？

#en: I wouldn't say no to a new Computer Core to dissect...
zh: 有新的计算机核心可以拆解，我不会拒绝……

#en: There we go, all done. Another Amp to add to my stock.
zh: 好了，完事。我的库存又多一个增幅。

#en: Review the slate, and we'll see what we can salvage...
zh: 看看数据板，我们看看能抢救出什么……

#en: You mentioned mental changes, you don't feel emotions?
zh: 你提到心理变化，你感觉不到情绪？

#en: Be certain, as constructing it will consume materials.
zh: 确定好，建造会消耗材料。

#en: Mind telling me about your modifications and implants?
zh: 能讲讲你的改装和植入体吗？

#en: I'll handle the build. Just... don't touch anything...
zh: 建造我来。只是……什么都别碰……

#en: Sure, we can do that. And maybe fit a Skydrop as well.
zh: 当然，可以。也许再装个空投。

#en: [5 Computer Cores] Skydrop - Turret Drop - Heavy Laser
zh: [5 计算机核心] 空投 - 炮塔空投 - 重型激光

#en: I've narrowed down the viable schematics. Take a look.
zh: 我筛出了可行的图纸。看看吧。

#en: Give me a sec, and I'll see what we're working with...
zh: 等我一下，我看看手头有什么……

#en: Oh boy, I think you already know the answer to that...
zh: 哦天，我想你已经知道答案了……

#en: Nope! Nothing at all. Think we've already seen it all.
zh: 不！什么都没发现。我觉得该看的都看过了。

#en: That's the idea! You take point, and I'll follow suit.
zh: 就是这么想的！你打头，我跟着。

#en: The more things change, the more they stay the same...
zh: 事物越是变化，就越是一成不变……

#en: Why only one Skydrop missile? You knew we'd need more.
zh: 为什么只有一枚空投导弹？你早知道我们需要更多。

#en: Facility you're looking for shouldn't be too far away.
zh: 你找的设施应该不远。

#en: Let's not waste any more time. How do we make a fleet?
zh: 别再浪费时间了。我们怎么组建舰队？

#en: I know about Watchtower, I've encountered them before.
zh: 我知道瞭望塔，我以前遇到过他们。

#en: Alright, here we go. New universe, same old game plan.
zh: 好，开始了。新宇宙，老套路。

#en: Oh, you don't know how glad I am that all this worked.
zh: 哦，你不知道我有多高兴这一切都成功了。

#en: That you know who we are only reinforces our concerns.
zh: 你知道我们是谁，只会加深我们的担忧。

#en: Prepare for involuntary power down and incapacitation.
zh: 准备接受强制断能和制服。

#en: I guess I'll think about visiting more Listening Posts.
zh: 我想我会考虑再去些监听哨。

#en: What do you mean by "tracking certain types of people"?
zh: 你说的「追踪某些类型的人」是什么意思？

#en: Okay! Lets see if we can find that intel Harper wanted.
zh: 好！看看我们能不能找到哈珀要的情报。

#en: Beats me. That's part of why I'm asking you to do this.
zh: 我也答不上来。这也是我让你去做这事的原因之一。

#en: But you did just fine without me! And I knew you would.
zh: 但没我也做得挺好！我就知道你能行。

#en: I hope we didn't take you away from anything important.
zh: 希望没耽误你什么要紧事。

#en: Let me know if you find something that intrigues you...
zh: 要是发现什么让你感兴趣的东西，告诉我……

#en: This Skydrop can be built, but it'll require materials.
zh: 这个空投可以造，但需要材料。

#en: We don't have any Skydrops at hand. Shall we build one?
zh: 我们手头没有空投。要造一个吗？

#en: Understood. Make your choice, and I'll handle the rest.
zh: 明白。你选好，剩下的我来。

#en: I'll just boot up the algorithm. Won't take a minute...
zh: 我把算法启动一下。马上就好……

#en: No time to talk! Let's take care of these drones first.
zh: 没空聊！先把这些无人机收拾了。

#en: Move into the facility. I'll meet you there when I can!
zh: 进设施里去。我尽快去那儿找你！

#en: Locked and loaded. Skydrop is on its way to the target!
zh: 已锁定装填。空投正飞向目标！

#en: Hah. I guess being Starborn sometimes has its benefits!
zh: 哈。看来当星裔有时也有好处！

#en: Well I'm Zippy, daring space adventurer extraordinaire!
zh: 我叫齐皮，英勇无畏的太空冒险家！

#en: Sure. Just tell me where this Listening Post is exactly.
zh: 当然。只要告诉我这监听哨的确切位置。

#en: ...I think that's what we ended up calling this place...
zh: ……我想我们后来就这么叫这地方了……

#en: Could you tell me a little about yourself, your history?
zh: 能简单介绍一下你自己和你的过往吗？

#en: Hm, yes I see. Some minor treatment, and you'll be fine.
zh: 嗯，我明白了。做点小治疗你就没事了。

#en: Besides a touch of hypochondria, you're absolutely fine!
zh: 除了一点点疑病症，你完全没事！

#en: I've got a decent stock of medical gear, if you need it?
zh: 我这儿的医疗装备存货不少，需要吗？

#en: I regret to inform you that your funds are insufficient.
zh: 很遗憾，你的资金不足。

#en: The build is done. I can fit it to a ship now, or later.
zh: 建造完成。现在装到船上，还是以后都行。

#en: Should we fabricate a Skydrop first? It might be useful.
zh: 我们先造个空投？也许有用。

#en: Didn't think I was that interesting, but sure, go ahead!
zh: 没想到我这么有趣，不过行，问吧！

#en: Seriously, you can't damage it while the shields are up!
zh: 说真的，护盾没关你伤不了它！

#en: ...What are you doing in here?! I need you outside. Now!
zh: ……你在这儿干什么？！我要你到外面去。现在！

#en: Absolutely! Next time I'll make sure it's not a problem.
zh: 当然！下次我会保证不成问题。

#en: That's almost all the power we need. Just a little more!
zh: 电力差不多够了。就差一点！

#en: Mark the facility with a flare. We'll blow it wide open!
zh: 用信号弹标记设施。我们把它炸开！

#en: Toss a flare on target, and we'll crack this thing open!
zh: 往目标扔个信号弹，我们把这东西撬开！

#en: The Advocate delivered. Got the Control Node right here!
zh: 辩护者送到了。控制节点就在这儿！

#en: Ah, Eridani III. Didn't think I'd see you again so soon!
zh: 啊，波江座III。没想到这么快又见到你！

#en: No problem! I already know all I need to know about you.
zh: 没问题！关于你，我该知道的都知道了。

#en: Thanks for telling me your plan. Don't need you anymore.
zh: 谢谢你告诉我你的计划。用不着你了。

#en: ...I still don't follow. Explain it to me like I'm five.
zh: ……我还是不明白。当我是五岁小孩给我解释。

#en: Okay, that's a fairly good plan. I can see that working.
zh: 好，这计划还不错。我看能行。

#en: For now, that's all I can do for you. I hope it's enough.
zh: 目前我能为你做的就这些。希望够用。

#en: ...Torin really should have prepared you better for this.
zh: ……托林真该让你做好更充分的准备。

#en: You got somewhere to be? Alright, I'll wait here for you.
zh: 你还有别处要去？好吧，我在这儿等你。

#en: He was almost a permanent guest at Watchtower's pleasure!
zh: 他差点就成了瞭望塔的永久「客人」！

#en: Tell me what you need. Med Pack, or a shiny new Cyberamp?
zh: 告诉我你需要什么。医疗包，还是崭新的赛博增幅？

#en: That would require more data. More data means more cores.
zh: 那需要更多数据。更多数据意味着更多核心。

#en: Construction successful. Skydrop ready for ship mounting.
zh: 建造成功。空投可装到船上。

#en: I'll begin the fabrication process, it won't take long...
zh: 我开始制造，不会太久……

#en: Give me a moment, the extraction process can be tricky...
zh: 等我一下，提取过程可能不太好弄……

#en: I believe this Skydrop can be extracted. Shall I proceed?
zh: 这个空投应该能提取。要我继续吗？

#en: Here's the slate with the current options. Choose wisely.
zh: 这是当前选项的数据板。好好挑。

#en: I'll need a moment to extract the required information...
zh: 我需要一点时间提取所需信息……

#en: No time for messing around! Come on, flip those switches!
zh: 没空磨蹭！快，去扳那些开关！

#en: Okay, then! I'll reach out and see if I can make contact.
zh: 那好！我试着联系一下，看能不能接上头。

#en: System's got a lock... Missile loaded. Skydrop deploying!
zh: 系统已锁定……导弹装填。空投部署！

#en: What's Watchtower doing here? Have they found us already?
zh: 瞭望塔在这儿干什么？他们已经找到我们了？

#en: All current station residents located in recreation area.
zh: 站内所有居民均位于休闲区。

#en: Launching the Armillary! If this doesn't deal with 'em...
zh: 发射浑天仪！这要是还收拾不了他们……

#en: You want fire from the sky? You'll get fire from the sky!
zh: 你要天降火力？那就给你天降火力！

#en: Attention. Our systems have flagged your ship as deviant.
zh: 注意。我们的系统已将你的飞船标记为异常体。

#en: ...Now, let's get you outta this and back to your ship...
zh: ……现在，让你脱离这里，回到你的飞船……

#en: One more ambush thwarted! I should start keeping a tally.
zh: 又挫败一次伏击！我该开始记数了。

#en: Hm. Maybe they sometimes use stations instead...? I dunno.
zh: 嗯。也许他们有时改用空间站……？不知道。

#en: You said something about giving Watchtower a bloody lip...
zh: 你说过要给瞭望塔一点颜色看看……

#en: She was almost a permanent guest at Watchtower's pleasure!
zh: 她差点就成了瞭望塔的永久「客人」！

#en: And now, I'm taking a short sabbatical to run this clinic!
zh: 而现在，我休假一段时间来经营这家诊所！

#en: I think I've got a few pieces that might catch your eye...
zh: 我想我有几件也许能入你眼的东西……

#en: The data's secure, that Cyberamp is ready for fabrication.
zh: 数据已到手，那个赛博增幅可以制造了。

#en: Another load of vessels scrapped. These credits are yours.
zh: 又拆了一批船。这些钱归你。

#en: I'm sorry, but you lack the needed credits for a resupply.
zh: 抱歉，你的钱不够补货。

#en: Review the slate. It lists all the Skydrops I can build...
zh: 看看数据板。上面列了我能造的所有空投……

#en: What do you think about Gren? Are you concerned about him?
zh: 你觉得格伦怎么样？你担心他吗？

#en: Huh. Good question. I'm not even sure I know the answer...
zh: 哦。问得好。我自己都不确定答案……

#en: You didn't come all this way just to stand there, did you?
zh: 你大老远来，不会只是为了站在那儿吧？

#en: We're done. Slate had intel on a Post way out on the edge.
zh: 完事了。数据板上有边缘地带一处监听哨的情报。

#en: [Find Array] Find me a Listening Post without using Intel.
zh: [寻找阵列] 不用情报，帮我找一个监听哨。

#en: Drop a flare so we can breach the facility and get inside!
zh: 扔个信号弹，我们好突破设施进去！

#en: I want to stay for a little longer, look around some more.
zh: 我想多待一会儿，再看看周围。

#en: Do we really need some special hardware to create a fleet?
zh: 组建舰队真的需要什么特殊硬件吗？

#en: They was almost a permanent guest at Watchtower's pleasure!
zh: 他们差点就成了瞭望塔的永久「客人」！

#en: You've got some serious issues! Let's treat them, shall we?
zh: 你的毛病可不轻！我们来治治，好吗？

#en: Not as bad as it could've been... Let's get you patched up.
zh: 没到最糟的地步……我们把你修好。

#en: Hm... You seem the very picture of health. Congratulations.
zh: 嗯……你看起来健康得很。恭喜。

#en: Sorry, you have insufficient credits for a Skydrop restock.
zh: 抱歉，你的钱不够为空投补货。

#en: Tell me about the <Alias.CurrentName=TargetDrop> Skydrop...
zh: 讲讲<Alias.CurrentName=TargetDrop>空投……

#en: I don't need all the details. Give me the abridged version.
zh: 细节不用全说。说简略版。

#en: If you're confident in your selection, I'll start building.
zh: 如果你确定选择，我就开始建造。

#en: This slate contains all Skydrops I can currently produce...
zh: 这块数据板上有我目前能制造的所有空投……

#en: There's no more Listening Posts out there. Nothing to find!
zh: 外面没有更多监听哨了。什么都找不到！

#en: M'kay. Intel pointed to a Post in a system not too far off.
zh: 好吧。情报指向不远处一个星系里的监听哨。

#en: ...You did it! Yes! Disruptor's got all the power it needs!
zh: ……你成功了！太好了！干扰器电力充足了！

#en: Well, there's the mech. Ready to make it regret coming out?
zh: 那台机甲出来了。准备好让它后悔露面了吗？

#en: Here you go, you'll need the Skydrop flare. Huh. D�j� Vu...
zh: 给你，你会需要空投信号弹。咦。似曾相识……

#en: If they're so "scared" of me, they should just stay away...
zh: 他们要是那么「怕」我，就该离远点……

#en: I happen to be a Senior Operative within Ryujin Industries.
zh: 我碰巧是龙神集团的高级特工。

#en: Hmm... Maybe I do know why Watchtower's interested in me...
zh: 嗯……也许我确实知道瞭望塔为什么对我感兴趣……

#en: Glad I got here in time! Was almost delayed by a UC patrol.
zh: 幸好我及时赶到！差点被联殖巡逻队耽误了。

#en: I'm not seeing any file... There's nothing in our database.
zh: 我没看到任何文件……我们的数据库里什么都没有。

#en: Can't say I know the answer to that. Data's thin on details.
zh: 这我可答不上来。数据里细节太少。
